content.text:
Edit ONE existing Gmail filter on tyson.goulding@optconnect.com (already signed in). Open https://mail.google.com/mail/u/0/#settings/filters

Find the filter whose From is like:
from:(donotreply@verizon.com OR devops@pws.bz OR no-reply@app.spendhound.com OR no-reply@drata.com OR no-reply@loggly.com OR no-reply@lattigo.com)
Actions: Skip Inbox, Mark as read, NOISE.

EDIT it (pencil/edit). Remove no-reply@lattigo.com from the From/OR list. Keep the others (verizon donotreply, devops@pws.bz, spendhound, drata, loggly). Save/update the filter.

If Gmail cannot edit in place: delete that one filter and recreate it WITHOUT no-reply@lattigo.com, same other senders, same actions (Skip Inbox, Mark as read, NOISE). Do not check "also apply" on recreate unless you are sure it will not re-archive Secure Token mail.

Do not change other filters. Do not send or delete mail.
If login/2FA is required, STOP and report.

Report the final From criteria of that filter and confirm no-reply@lattigo.com is gone.
